findings.reproduction: In a temporary candidate root create tests/receipts as a symlink to a separate temporary outside directory. Set helper ROOT to that temporary candidate and replace expensive verify with a synthetic-only successful result. Invoke main with receipt tests/receipts/new.json. Both destination.resolve() and allowed-root.resolve() point outside, so the containment test passes and outside/new.json is created.
findings.impact: Exclusive create prevents overwriting existing files but does not preserve the declared candidate-only write boundary. A directory symlink can redirect a new receipt into another directory, potentially the installed project or stable store. The check followed by delayed path open also leaves a parent replacement race.
findings.required: Keep a fixed candidate root, reject symlink parent/leaf paths using directory descriptors and NOFOLLOW, reserve a new output inode exclusively before verification and retain that descriptor for the final write. Do not clean up failure by an attacker-replaceable pathname. Preserve existing source, receipts and original artifacts.
